hook: England rugby stars secured a record 45-22 victory over Australia at London's Allianz Stadium today.

sections.voiceover: England rugby stars secured a record 45-22 victory over Australia at London's Allianz Stadium today.
Which player sparked this second-half surge for head coach Steve Borthwick's dominant England rugby side?
However, the game shifted when Max Jorgensen scored an intercept try right at half-time.

Replacing the injured Immanuel Feyi-Waboso, Henry Pollock scored two second-half tries for the team. Seven tries total proved that Steve Borthwick's tactical substitutions were absolutely decisive for England.
That performance set a new 45-point record for England against the Wallabies at Twickenham.
